verdict.rationale: Fireworks documents a global fleet of deployment regions so users can 'meet data-residency needs' and run multi-region deployments. It also offers a US-only Serverless mode that serves inference exclusively from the US for compliance, so users can choose where workloads run. missing for 10: explicit documentation that stored data (datasets, uploaded models, logs) stays in the chosen region, the list of available regions and how to select them, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
